dynamic_line.yes: *glares at your marshal badge.  "I said, keep *walking*, G-man."
dynamic_line.no: *spits on the ground, glancing at where your marshal badge would have been, and shaking his head.  "Nice try.  You can take off the badge, but I know what you are, I'm not some country rube.  Get out."

responses.text: <color_green>[Social 3]</color> I swear, I'm not here to cause trouble.  I just volunteer with those guys to help travelers, things like that.  I don't speak for them.
<color_yellow>[Social <3]</color> I took it off man, what more do you want from me?
